text: それでは　なにを　そだてて　みるかね？

structure.jp: なにを　そだてて　みるかね？
structure.en: what will you try having raised?

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus みる means to try doing something and see how it goes. そだてて　みる = 'try raising it'.

patterns.name: 〜かね
patterns.explanation: かね is a soft way of asking a question used by older men. みるかね = 'will you try it, hm?'
